 The Position
   

  

 This position is available in the DAIV System Team, a centralized DevOps and software infrastructure team based in Bangalore and supporting multiple software product development teams across the EMEA region. These teams develop desktop and web applications for data management, image processing, and visualization workflows. The DAIV System Team provides CI/CD infrastructure, software lifecycle management, developer tooling, AI enablement, and cybersecurity support across the software development lifecycle. As a DevOps Engineer, you will contribute to the CI/CD, software lifecycle management, developer tooling, AI enablement, and cybersecurity capabilities used by desktop and web product teams. Working with senior engineers and technical leads, you will implement automation, support product teams, resolve delivery issues, and build brad experience across modern DevOps technologies.
   

  

 How You Will Make an Impact
   

  

 You will help development teams deliver software more efficiently by maintaining reliable pipelines, automating repetitive work, and resolving build and deployment issues.
   

  

 You will contribute to secure, consistent engineering practices while learning how complex desktop and web products are built, tested, packaged, and released.
   

  

 You will work in an international, collaborative environment with opportunities to develop technical depth in a desktop or web application track.

* Implement, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines and supporting DevOps infrastructure under the guidance of senior engineers and technical leads.
* Support product teams with build, test, packaging, deployment, release, and software lifecycle management activities.
* Create and maintain scripts, pipeline components, automation, and documentation that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Support GitHub or GitLab repositories, runners or agents, artifact management, access patterns, and related developer tooling.

 The ideal candidate is a practical and curious software or DevOps engineer with solid engineering fundamentals, a strong learning mindset, and the discipline to build reliable, maintainable automation.
   

  

 Besides that, you have:
   

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree with 3 to 6 years of DevOps industry experience.

* Experience with software development or DevOps fundamentals, including version control, CI/CD, scripting, automated testing, and systematic troubleshooting.
